newsitem.title: UK: GEC, Smiths, Serco bid for RAF base.
newsitem.headline: GEC, Smiths, Serco bid for RAF base.

text.p: Two British aeronautical engineering companies, GEC-Marconi and Smiths Industries, have teamed up with faciliies management group Serco to form a bidding consortium to manage and operate a Royal Air Force site called RAF Sealand in northwest England.

The bidding team, formed into a joint venture team called GSS Sealand Ltd, will seek to "expand the role of RAF Sealand by strengthening its capability whilst extending the business base through cooperative arrangements within the industry."
The GSS bid has been submitted, a statement from the companies added, but the firms did not comment on what they thought their competitive prospects were or how soon they expected a decision.
